description: Header file defining the QrCode class for generating and manipulating QR codes, including encoding functions, drawing patterns, and error correction.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Class representing a QR code, with methods for creation, encoding, and rendering.

classes.name: QrCode::ReedSolomonGenerator
classes.description: Helper class for computing Reed-Solomon error correction codewords.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Creates a QR code from a text string with specified error correction and minimum version.

methods.name: encodeBinary
methods.description: Creates a QR code from binary data with specified error correction.

methods.name: encodeSegments
methods.description: Creates a QR code from data segments with flexible encoding parameters.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the QR code.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (width and height) of the QR code in modules.

methods.name: getErrorCorrectionLevel
methods.description: Returns the error correction level used.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the color of a specific module (pixel) in the QR code.

methods.name: toSvgString
methods.description: Generates an SVG string representation of the QR code with specified border padding.
